# Agent Journal

## Findings
- Root cause: `django/db/models/fields/__init__.py` — `Field.__eq__` compared only `creation_counter`, so two fields cloned from the same abstract base onto different models compared equal and collapsed in sets. `__hash__` used only `creation_counter` too.
- Fix applied (minimal, source only): `__eq__` now also requires `getattr(self, 'model', None) == getattr(other, 'model', None)`; `__hash__` is `hash((self.creation_counter, self.model))`. `__lt__` left ordering by `creation_counter` first, per the issue's guidance (avoids re-ordering unaffected cases).
- Verified: inline check shows `B._meta.get_field('myfield') != C._meta.get_field('myfield')`, set size 2, self-equality holds, hashes differ. Exit 0.
- Shell cwd is the project root (`django-13401-nopanel`); the campaign path only hosts the venv. runtests.py needs `PYTHONPATH=.`.
- No `tests/fields` package in this checkout; field tests live in `tests/field_deconstruction`, `tests/field_subclassing`, `tests/migrations`, etc.

## Leads
- Run `PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python tests/runtests.py field_deconstruction field_subclassing basic migrations` to check for regressions.

## Questions
- (none)

## Decisions
- Kept `__lt__` on `creation_counter` only — the issue explicitly warns ordering by model first broke a test upstream.
- Did not touch tests; no commit made.
